description: The Contract for Ground Handling Services for the SriLankan Airlines at the Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport in France
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the limited international competitive bidding procedure for awarding the Passenger and Ground Handling Services Contract for the SriLankan Airlines at the Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport, France. Four (04) bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendations of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award the said contracts as follows, was approved by the Cabinet:to award the contract for the Passenger and Ramp Handling Services to Groupe Europe Handling, for a sum of euro 7.73 million, for a period of 03 years from 2026-04-01.to award the contract of Cargo Warehouse Handling Services to France Handling Cargo, the substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of euro 1.90 million, for a period of 03 years from 2026-02-01.
